_comment: A REAL course, not a placeholder: catalog_sync is get-or-create with no reconciliation pass, so anything this creates keeps its enrolments in Moodle forever. Every unit below is taught today — the coverage gate reads the criteria back off the built pages — so this course arrives with its grade items already meaning something.
title: Digital Skills for the Workshop
_level: TVET has levels, not grades. levelKind is carried end to end so nothing downstream reads levelNumber as a school year.
summary: The computer inside a meter, an inverter and a chiller; getting a site connected and diagnosing it when it will not; hardware against software; and the machines that start without being asked. A CORE module: every trade here now works beside an embedded computer and none of them calls it one.
_progressPartition: The catalogue's units — and therefore the Moodle grade items — are UNITS OF COMPETENCY, not lessons. A lesson may teach parts of two units and a unit may span two lessons, and it is the unit a certificate names.
curriculumFramework: Professor Adow TVET — Digital Skills for the Workshop
_units: `data` is relative to this file. A unit joins the catalogue on the day its JSON ships. assessmentMode is the DOMINANT mode of the unit's criteria; the per-criterion split is in the unit file. NOT trade-reviewed.
